latest.title: Weekend Creative Challange: Gravity(poem generator)
latest.description:
The Gravity Poem Generator is a web app that turns poetry into motion. Words fall, bounce, and interact with the canvas as if pulled by gravity, creating a playful mix of art and physics.

Users can input text or generate random words, and the app animates them dynamically. Each run produces a unique visual experience, making poetry feel alive.

Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, it uses a lightweight physics simulation to animate text. Hosted on GitHub Pages, it’s accessible to anyone with a browser.

latest.title: Your AI Agent Runs Untrusted Code. Sandbox It the Way AWS Sandboxes Lambda — on an EC2 Bare-Metal Instance
latest.description: kindling is an open source runtime that gives every AI tool (MCP server) its own Firecracker microVM — frozen on disk at zero cost, awake in milliseconds. Here's the problem it solves, how it works, the engineering behind it (shared Chromium, copy-on-write memory, per-session secrets), and how to run it on an EC2 bare-metal instance, x86 or Graviton.

latest.title: Weekend Creative Challenge: Pujangga (Poem Generator)
latest.description: Your AI Indonesian wordsmith: turn any theme into a pantun, a cheesy gombal, rap bars, an aesthetic caption, or a short puisi, written in seconds by Amazon Bedrock (Nova). It even replies to your pantun, and every creation joins a shared wall. Serverless on Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB & Bedrock.
